code:
use default

class ENVIRONMENT(value: int public, count: int public)

hailstone_step(env: ENVIRONMENT) is
    if env.value != 1 then
        env.value = if env.value % 2 == 0
            then env.value / 2
            else 3 * env.value + 1
            fi

        env.count = env.count + 1
    fi
si

let environments = (1..13)
    |> map(value => ENVIRONMENT(value, 0))
    |> collect_list()

while !(environments |> all(env => env.value == 1)) do
    environments |> each(hailstone_step)
    write_line(environments |> map(env => "{env.value}") |> join(" "))
od

write_line(environments |> map(env => "{env.count}") |> join(" "))
